evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: When do you plan in moving... You mentioned this is a house, going to a house which the square footage. The square footage of the home is 2200 square feet.
evidence_quotes.walkthrough_branch: Mm-hmm, it's 26 foot box truck. It can only fit in 1700 square foot home though... normally we do the virtual walkthrough in that way we can be able to check if that can fit into one truck.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: No recognizable version asked; rep moved directly into logistics probing after availability check.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: We don't need anyone to pack us, does that matter? For packing, normally, it will double the cost.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Not asked as per rubric definition.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Virtual walkthrough confirmed for tomorrow at 10:00 AM with email link, phone reminder, and voicemail backup. Reservation held for Sunday (4 movers, 2 trucks) pending virtual walkthrough adjustment.

top_strength: Rep correctly identified a 2,200 sq ft move as requiring a virtual walkthrough, offered it unprompted, explained the value (pricing based on actual items rather than square footage), and confirmed a clean handoff with date/time, contact method, and contingency plan.
coaching_note: Ask 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?' before diving into logistics details — this call moved straight from availability into probing without ever checking the customer's actual agenda.
